whyItPrints: Bandwidth bought wholesale and sold by the gigabyte, with a dashboard on top.
whyThisMatters:
Residential, datacenter-style, and mobile proxies, bought from two big upstreams and resold. The seller says signup, payment, support, fraud checks, and renewals run themselves. They also say more than eight thousand accounts and a bit over two hundred paying customers. Stripe shows more subscriptions than that paying-customer line. I am leaving both. Started in July 2023. No name. No site.

The monthly subscription line is well under the cash in a typical month. September was the high one. October is down. The last year is a large share of the all-time total. Margin is claimed at sixty percent. For sale since April, with a lot of offers. The work in this business is abuse and fraud, not a feature list.

You pay by the gigabyte for an address that is not a datacenter everyone already blocked.
